description:
logctl, the attach-API and local-JMX client for the level-control
    surface (doc/logaperture-spec.md §8.1, doc/specs/cli-transport.md). A
    standalone tool, never shaded into a customer artifact; it is a client
    of a running agent, not a peer of it, so it must not depend on
    logaperture-agent (enforced below, mirroring core's own rule).
